facets.name: Skin Thief
facets.description: The Uratha wears a slain human or predator's skin as his own.
facets.activationRequirement: Use only in Hishu. Skin a human or a predatory animal roughly the size of a wolf, taking enough skin to cover the shoulders, and wear it.
facets.effect: Copy the deceased's appearance, bone structure, and muscle. A human copy is physically perfect until the Uratha willingly sheds the stolen skin or shapeshifts, tearing out of it. An animal copy changes Urhan's appearance to that predator for one lunar month without otherwise changing its traits. Spend 1 Willpower to keep the animal appearance indefinitely, until copying another animal with this Facet or choosing to return Urhan to a wolf's shape. In either case, the Uratha's eyes remain his own rather than matching the copied prey.

facets.name: The Father's Form
facets.description: Take Father Wolf's shape while suppressing the madness that normally drives Gauru.
facets.effect: Shift into Gauru outside combat without constantly attacking or falling into Kuruth. Regenerate as in other forms rather than benefiting from Gauru's regeneration, do not automatically benefit from Down and Dirty combat, and inflict Lunacy as Urshul. Making any attack or suffering more than Purity Renown in lethal damage during the scene ends this Facet and restores the normal Gauru rules (p. 97). Shifting to another form to end this Facet is a breaking point toward Flesh.

facets.name: Gaze of the Moon
facets.description: Silver eyes channel the Moon's madness into a human witness.
facets.activationRequirement: Target one human who can clearly see the Uratha's eyes.
facets.effect: The prey suffers the full effects of Lunacy as though the Uratha were in Gauru. The Uratha chooses which of the three Lunacy Conditions is inflicted.

facets.name: Luna's Embrace
facets.description: Change sex as readily as changing form.
facets.effect: Change the Uratha's sex until using this Facet again to change back. The change is biologically complete and functional; the new appearance resembles a twin brother or sister of the old self.

facets.name: Quicksilver Flesh
facets.description: Mix features of different forms by reshaping part of the Uratha's body.
facets.effect: Choose one benefit available to the current form each time this Facet is used. Other changes require agreement between player and Storyteller. Obviously unnatural changes to Hishu or Urhan inflict Lunacy as Dalu.
facets.options:
Honed Senses: +3 to Perception checks (Hishu).
Grasping Hands: paws become hands capable of gripping and manipulating (Urshul, Urhan).
Loping Stride: +2 Speed (Hishu, Dalu, Gauru).
Razor Talons: claws deal 1 lethal damage (Hishu, Dalu, Urhan).
Maw of Man: speak human languages clearly, but lose any bite attack (Urshul, Urhan).

facets.name: Honed Senses
facets.description: Notice the small details on which a hunt's outcome depends.
facets.effect: Perception rolls achieve exceptional success with three successes instead of five.

facets.name: Cow the Prey
facets.description: The prey knows that this hunter cannot be stopped.
facets.activationRequirement: Spend the Essence when activating the Uratha's hunter's aspect.
facets.effect: The associated Condition becomes Persistent. The prey gains a Beat when turning a successful roll against the werewolf into a dramatic failure.

facets.name: Beast Talker
facets.description: The Uratha understands the languages of animals.
facets.effect: Communicate with and understand any known animal. Animals retain their limited understanding of the world and are likely to fear a werewolf. This Facet permits Social Maneuvering against an animal.

facets.name: Tireless Hunter
facets.description: Endure the hunt without surrendering to exhaustion or hunger.
facets.effect: While this Facet is active and the Uratha has Siskur-Dah, ignore up to Purity Renown in penalties from tiredness, fatigue, and poor morale. Ignore Conditions preventing Willpower expenditure only when the action advances the hunt toward its culmination. The Uratha does not need to eat or drink, but cannot maintain this benefit for more than Purity Renown consecutive days. Afterwards, gorge and drink over at least one day of rest.

facets.name: Impossible Spoor
facets.description: Follow traces too subtle or unusual for ordinary senses.
facets.effect: Add two successes to each successful Tracking roll (p. 94), but none to a failed roll. Spend 1 Essence to remove all penalties from the trail's age. Spend additional Essence to negate the penalty each time environmental conditions would degrade the trail (p. 94). Even an ancient trail or hostile weather leaves something the Uratha can follow.

facets.name: Reflected Facets
facets.description: Packmates guide the Uratha's Gifts or receive their personal benefits.
facets.effect: Use Gifts against prey the Uratha cannot personally sense if a packmate can sense it, paying 1 Essence in addition to the Facet's normal cost. This gives no awareness of when the packmate can sense the prey; coordinate through other Gifts, signals, or technology. Alternatively, activate a Facet that enhances its user rather than targeting prey and pay 1 additional Essence to transfer its effects to a chosen packmate. The Uratha cannot reactivate that Facet while it is in use, but may reflexively cancel the transfer. Both uses have a range of Cunning Renown in miles.

facets.name: Down the Prey
facets.description: Exploit an opening made by a packmate's attack.
facets.activationRequirement: Use when hitting an enemy injured by a packmate since the Uratha's last turn.
facets.effect: Choose one of the listed effects against the prey.
facets.options:
Impose −2 on the prey's next dice pool.
Gain +2 Defense against that prey for one turn.
Inflict Knocked Down if the prey's Defense against the attack was 0.

facets.name: Totem's Wrath
facets.description: Force the totem into a Gauru-like body filled with Death Rage. Even violent totems commonly regard this as violating their bargain; using it may severely damage the relationship with the pack.
facets.dicePool: Presence + Occult + Honor vs Power + Finesse + Resistance
facets.effect: The totem immediately gains Materialized and a fleshly, Gauru-like shell: Power +3, Finesse +1, Resistance +2, Size 7, with the printed derived changes Corpus +2, Initiative +1, and Speed +4. Apply Defense against Firearms, inflict Lunacy, and use Primal Fear as a Gauru werewolf. Follow Basu-Im rules, except the totem never attacks a packmate with the Totem Merit; its actions may cause other packmates to enter Basu-Im. Lose 1 Essence each turn. At 0 Essence or when dismissed by the Uratha who used this Facet, the totem bursts into ephemera. Once dismissed, it withdraws for one day per turn it was active. During that withdrawal, the pack cannot use the totem's bonuses or Gifts and Rites requiring its presence, including this Facet.

facets.name: Maw of Madness
facets.description: The Uratha's bite carries the Moon's maddening taint.
facets.activationRequirement: Use when a bite successfully damages a living victim who is not an Uratha.

facets.name: Pack Awareness
facets.description: The pack's members remain connected through the Uratha's spirit.
facets.effect: Permanently sense each packmate's general location relative to the Uratha, state, and wellbeing within Wisdom Renown miles. The Uratha cannot be surprised by an enemy any packmate is aware of, making ambush difficult when with the pack. Spend 1 Essence to speak mind-to-mind with any visible packmate for one scene.
